tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the markets Swiftedge covers, with a link to each live order book heatmap.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest, large trades in the last 24 hours and the USD value of measured liquidations within 1, 2, 5 and 10 % of pr

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_snapshot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest and large trades in the last 24 hours, with links to the live heatmap on swiftedge.uk." → after: "Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest, large trades in the last 24 hours and the USD value of measured liquidations within 1, 2, 5 and 10 % of pr"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

description: OHLC candles with volume split into aggressive buying and selling, delta per candle and cumulative volume delta (CVD).

description.name: get_large_trades
description.description: Large aggressive market orders in the last 24 hours: buy and sell totals, per hour, the 10 largest and the 10 latest.

description.name: get_liquidations
description.description: Liquidations that really happened in the last 1-24 hours: longs and shorts liquidated in USD, per hour and the 10 largest.

description.name: get_liquidation_heatmap
description.description: Where leveraged positions would be liquidated within 5 % of price (the latest column of the liquidation heatmap): USD totals within 2 % and 5 % and the largest clusters above and below.

description.name: get_funding_and_open_interest
description.description: Funding rate (8-hour and annualized), next funding time, funding history, open interest with 1/4/24-hour change and its history.

description.name: get_key_levels
description.description: Today's important prices sorted above and below the live price, with the distance in percent: order book walls, positioning levels, today's high, low and open, and the largest liquidation clusters.

description.name: get_economic_calendar
description.description: Upcoming economic releases (CPI, jobs, central banks and more) for the next 1-30 days, each with how much the markets have moved in the first hour after past releases of the same kind.

description.name: get_research_studies
description.description: Swiftedge's published studies (economic release impact, liquidation map, GEX pinning test, order book liquidity by hour, opening range breakouts) with links and headline findings.
